formal_contract.SAT_model: An input-derived speculative assignment is accepted iff all original constraints agree, confirmed by separately implemented Boolean verifier.
formal_contract.repair_energy: E(x) = count of violated original clauses; flip a single bit only on strict decrease.
formal_contract.termination_bound: integer E decreases at least 1 per accepted flip; <= clause_count steps; no nontrivial repair-cycle possible.
formal_contract.stall: Local minimum with E>0 MUST be LOCAL_MINIMUM_NOT_UNSAT, no UNSAT inference permitted.
formal_contract.fallback: C023 independent proof remains authoritative at scale; n<=10 research DPLL exhaustively checks UNSAT.
formal_contract.toy_fixed_points: Finite mapping fixed point x=T(x), nonfixed 2-cycle rejected, multiple fixed points admitted.
formal_contract.causality: Strict PENROSE-003 workflow DAG continues to prohibit FINAL_GATE -> UFR_PRODUCE edge; heuristic loop is not execution dependency.
